claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: On the byte-identical synthetic fixture (40 alias-OOD: 30 orthogonal 3 families x10 +10 mixed header+body+query, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty, per-task registry size 3) hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation retrieval + genuine reconstruction resolves alias-OOD 40/40 (1.0 Wilson [0.912,1.0] binomial p~1e-40 vs 0.10 McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH 0/40) without increasing false_accept (0.0 <=0.15, 1.0 below verbatim), preserving exact-match 12/12 and no-applicable/empty abstention (ECE 0.1076 CI [0.0882,0.1149] <=0.15) and not dominated by flat retrieval. Retrieval complementarity (coverage gain >=0.15, density gain >0 with p<0.05) NOT demonstrated on this substrate: coverage identically 1.0 for all pipelines because pool (3) <= k=5 makes gain structurally 0.0 (bootstrap CI [0,0] p=1.0); hierarchical index fragmented to 63 singleton themes under frozen Jaccard 0.6 so aggregation contributed no grouping. Thus bounded MIXED: resolution not regressing but complementarity advantage not evidenced. No inference to live BrowserGym/WebShop/ALFWorld, production SPA DOM/AX heterogeneity, or pool>>k where flat truncation could occur. Does not falsify hierarchical retrieval in general; does falsify that theme-diversified retrieval beats flat top-5 RAG on this minimal-derived-dict synthetic with k>=pool.
